new_today_news.headline: SAF Production Doubled to Two Million Tonnes in 2025 as Industry Shifts Focus From Climate to Strategic Resilience
new_today_news.summary: Global sustainable aviation fuel production doubled to roughly two million tonnes in 2025, with the industry now emphasizing energy security alongside climate goals, per the SkyNRG & ICF SAF Market Outlook 2026. Used cooking oil is a primary feedstock for SAF production.

new_today_news.headline: 2026 Waste to Energy and Materials Technical Assistance for state, local, and Tribal governments program announced
new_today_news.summary: The DOE's Alternative Fuels and Feedstocks Office launched technical assistance for waste-to-energy initiatives. The program provides no-cost expert support to 16 state, local, and tribal entities, with expansion to include wastewater streams and industrial byproducts—relevant to FOG-to-energy conversion pathways.

new_today_news.headline: Grease Trap Neglect Raises the Risk of Overflows, Sewer Backups and Costly Plumbing Repairs for Los Angeles Restaurants
new_today_news.summary: Los Angeles restaurants face operational pressures from commercial drainage system demands as grease trap maintenance becomes critical to avoid service disruptions. The article discusses how FOG accumulation in wastewater systems creates ongoing risks requiring professional grease management services.

new_today_news.headline: Austin Water Launches Grease Trap Relief Program
new_today_news.summary: Austin Water's Utility Compliance Services Division launched the Grease Trap Relief Program on October 1, 2026, offering no-cost grease trap equipment and installation or replacement to qualifying food service establishments. The program represents potential savings of $30,000 or more per business and includes a new FOG risk-based system to determine variance eligibility.

new_today_news.headline: Pumps and Solids Reduction Unit Increase FOG Receiving Efficiency
new_today_news.summary: Northeast Environmental reports on infrastructure improvements to FOG handling operations, including installation of specialized pumps for handling fats, oils and grease waste from area restaurants. The wastewater facility separates fats, oils and grease, and prepares dewatered solids that can be composted, anaerobically digested, or incinerated.

new_today_news.headline: Hooters Closes Dozens of Restaurants After Bankruptcy, and Entire States Going Dark
new_today_news.summary: Hooters continues to shrink its footprint after emerging from bankruptcy in 2026, closing dozens of locations and exiting several states. Questions remain about whether the sports bar chain's model remains viable in the current market.

new_today_news.headline: Southern California Restaurants Face Scrutiny as Improper Grease Disposal Threatens Sewer Systems and Triggers Blockages
new_today_news.summary: Southern California's restaurant industry generates significant FOG that must be professionally managed through grease trap pumping and interceptor maintenance. Improper grease disposal triggers recurring blockages and operational disruptions requiring vacuum truck services.

recent_news.headline: Chain Restaurants Are Closing Hundreds of Locations Across the US in 2026
recent_news.summary: Major restaurant chains including Wendy's, Papa John's, Pizza Hut, and Starbucks announced significant closure plans in 2026 driven by inflation, rising labor costs, and shifting customer preferences. Wendy's closed 289 US restaurants in the first half of 2026.

recent_news.headline: Restaurants Added Nearly 60K Jobs in August
recent_news.summary: August 2026 employment data shows eating and drinking places added 59,200 jobs seasonally adjusted, the largest single-month increase since January 2023. Restaurant industry remains in moderate payroll expansion despite uneven month-to-month changes.
